## What happened?

Describe the expected and actual behavior.

## Reproduction

Include the smallest code and inputs that reproduce the problem. For numeric or
geometry bugs, include raw Q32.32 values when rounding matters. For random
streams, include the seed and call order. Remove private data.

For nondeterministic results, include both outputs and the inputs used by each
runtime.
